11: The machine acted as a mirror reflecting the room’s shared understanding. (C16)
12: The roster signified that the room had achieved a collective mental state. (C22)
13: The trolley carried the entire system – machine, resolver, names – to the next location. (C23)
14: Understanding and expression are intertwined; expression opens doors and feeds the mirror. (C24)
15: The process involves understanding, expressing, feeding the mirror, and repeating the cycle. (C25)

18: The machine’s operation was based on mutual understanding and consent, not passwords or scans. (C29)
